spec: Flight spends its positive power allowance before activation movement, never increasing the activation balance on a short jump. Negative modifiers remain a movement penalty. Shared controller and simulation resolution must agree through save/restore and Surge.
expect: Two data-authored flight bonuses demonstrate short, bonus-boundary, beyond-bonus and full-range costs. Every advertised landing executes with nonnegative payment and never adds movement; invalid landing attempts spend nothing. Existing flight ladder and control hashes are unchanged.
note: Reproduced before implementation: a +3 flight bonus over one hex raised movePointsLeft from 5 to 7. Test powers are test-lane fixtures, not new gameplay tuning. Advance snapshot rules version because the corrected resource accounting changes semantics.
